name: LYSINE CLONIXINATE / DICLOFENAC 250/50MG 14 TABLETS DORIXINA
description: What pain does lysine clonixinate relieve? It is indicated as an analgesic and anti-inflammatory in patients with acute or chronic pain. It is used for soft tissue conditions, headaches, ear pain, sinusitis, and herpes zoster. It is also used for gynecological, orthopedic, urological, and general surgery pain and procedures. Diclofenac is a nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) used to relieve pain, inflammation, and swelling. It is commonly used to treat conditions such as osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, and menstrual pain. It requires a prescription.
